# L4.3 — CI supply-chain hardening: {ubuntu,macOS} matrix, cargo-deny, gitleaks, dependabot, live-verify dispatch, full-run reader (R-2.12.4)

Ticket: `docs/tickets/164r_L4.3__ci-supply-chain-hardening.md` · seq 164r · base `svitali/harnessharness-l4.2` · stacked on #188.

## Summary

Hardens CI for a public repo: an ubuntu + macOS build/test matrix (the
helper's seatbelt backend is macOS-native), cargo-deny + gitleaks as
gating jobs, dependabot, SHA-pinned actions, a `cargo doc -D warnings`
gate, and the operator's *"Local + manual workflow"* ruling landed as a
dispatch-only `live-verify` workflow bound to the protected Environment —
dormant-safe, USD 0 spent, first dispatch is the operator's (HUMAN-H6).
Also carries the R4.2a D6-fallback transfer: the `full-run.sh read`
reader (contract D-D) + its gh-shim self-test.

## What changed

- **`ci.yml`** — `build-test-drift` gains a `{ubuntu-latest,
  macos-latest}` matrix (`fail-fast: false`); each leg runs the fast-path
  decision and uploads its own `$RUNNER_OS`-named anchor (ADR-0362);
  node 22 + python 3.13 provisioned for the E2/E3 foreign legs on both
  legs; a `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --workspace --no-deps`
  gate on the ubuntu leg; **cargo-deny** and **gitleaks** jobs declared
  *before* `build-test-drift`; `actions: read` retained; every `uses:`
  pinned by 40-hex commit SHA + `# v…` comment (each verified to resolve
  and tag-match).
- **`deny.toml` + cargo-deny job** — licenses allow-list
  (MIT/Apache/ISC/MPL family + BSD-3-Clause + CDLA-Permissive-2.0 for
  webpki-roots), advisories, bans (warn-with-reason), sources =
  crates.io only. `cargo deny check` surfaced **RUSTSEC-2026-0382**
  (rustls-webpki =0.103.15) + the sibling webpki-roots =1.0.9 advisory —
  pins moved to `rustls-webpki =0.103.16` / `webpki-roots =1.0.10`
  inside ADR-0365's closed scope via its own "pin bumps by sibling ADR"
  revisit path (ADR-0378); lockfile + THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES regenerated;
  dated note on ADR-0365.
- **gitleaks job** — consumes the one committed `.gitleaks.toml` (CC1 —
  the R4.5a config, test-PKI allowlist already landed), over
  `--log-opts=--all` (fetch-depth 0) plus the PR diff; the binary is a
  version+sha256-pinned tarball, not an unpinned action.
- **`.github/workflows/live-verify.yml`** — `workflow_dispatch` only,
  `environment: live-verify`, secrets materialised NAME-only under
  umask 077, legs selected by input, run-produced evidence uploaded as an
  artifact. The dispatch-only guard is lint-enforced:
  `scripts/ci/check-live-verify-workflow.sh` + a 5-mutation self-test
  wired into the step-mode lint step.
- **`scripts/ci/full-run.sh read <sha>`** — implements ADR-0362 contract
  D-D verbatim (pass/fail/pending/missing/unknown; M9 — a cancelled job
  never reads pass) + `test-full-run.sh` with a `gh` shim serving real
  GitHub-API-shape fixture JSON; the AC-1 third self-test.
- **`.github/dependabot.yml`** — github-actions weekly + cargo
  security-only (`open-pull-requests-limit: 0`).
- **rustdoc sweep** — ~55 broken intra-doc links fixed doc-only across
  ~25 crates (crate-qualified links, `mod@` disambiguation, de-links to
  code font, `&lt;` escapes) so the new `-D warnings` gate lands green
  (ADR-0378 D8 — the ticket's MINOR-6 amendment made fixing every
  surfaced warning mandatory).
- **ADR-0378** — all owned decisions (matrix/anchor shape, deny policy,
  gitleaks pin shape, dispatch-only binding, pin-bump authority, the
  rustdoc sweep rule); generated `docs/adr/README.md` +
  `REVISIT_TRIGGERS.md` regenerated; dated notes on ADR-0365 +
  `runs/R4.2a.md`; `AGENTS.md` reader line for `full-run.sh`.
